links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated RARP patient education against recommended 6th-8th grade level
links.effect: All three models (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Doubao) exceeded commonly recommended sixth- to eighth-grade reading levels; DeepSeek text was comparatively easier to read.
links.quote: DeepSeek generated comparatively easier-to-read text, although all three models exceeded commonly recommended sixth- to eighth-grade reading levels for public-facing health materials.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality, readability, and accuracy of patient education information generated by three LLMs (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Doubao) for robot-assisted radical prostatectomy via expert clinician grading, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
